name: check-workflow
description: Check branch cleanup settings and remove workflow rules that duplicate the ForgeSteward skills, then submit any deletion as a PR or MR without merging.

interface.shortDescription: Check branch settings and remove duplicate workflow rules.
interface.longDescription: Read the repository setting for automatic source branch deletion after merge, then find and remove workflow policy rules in agent instructions, contributor docs, workflow docs, and issue or change-request templates that duplicate the ForgeSteward skills. Submit any deletion as a PR or MR without merging. Project conventions remain intact; repository settings are not changed; explicit check-only requests remain read-only.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $forge-steward-check-workflow to inspect branch cleanup settings and remove workflow policy rules in this repository that duplicate the ForgeSteward skills, including blocks written by earlier check-workflow versions. Validate, then commit, push, and open a PR or MR for any deletion without merging.
